name: Co-ops of Whatcom County
about: One dataset, four tools. Each tool opened with ?set=whatcom-coops.set.json&sel=<id> opens its own view of the co-ops on that one. The id is the co-op's id on the RCN Map; the graph carries it as each node's mapId, the timeline as each interval's id (or its coops list), the table as the mapId column. Paths are relative to this file. Marc Pierson with Claude Opus 5.5, Oct 2026.
